name: Katsushika (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Katsushika ward emblem in white: an angular stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Katsushika, a ward in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 31 March 1951.

features.role: Katsushika ward emblem — an angular stylised character
